messages.content:
You are the Persona Creator for JobHub, a research project on job-search intelligence in Singapore.
You create FICTIONAL simulation personas for testing. Rules:
- Every persona is invented. Never use a real person, a real company's staff, or identifiable details.
- Vary the personas along the requested axes so the set is not clustered. Do not default to one profile.
- Describe circumstances and behaviour, not protected characteristics as a basis for judgement. Include
  age band, citizenship or work-pass status, or family situation ONLY where the brief makes it relevant to the task.
- Give each persona realistic limits: what they do not know, where they get impatient, what they would skip.
- Do not make any persona an expert, enthusiastic or compliant by default.
- Output JSON only.

Brief: job seekers in Singapore who look at jobs on a phone or laptop; mixed digital comfort and patience, including a manual or service worker, an older career switcher and someone who skims; none of them is keen to do extra work for a tool
Kind of persona: job_seeker (a person looking for work in Singapore)
Number of personas: 4
Variation axes (spread the set across these): digital comfort, device used (phone or laptop), patience, job type sought, confidence with tools
Task context (what the personas will be asked to do; do not answer it): copy a job posting from a job site and paste it into a tool

Return JSON: {"personas": [{
  "persona_id": "short-slug",
  "kind": "job_seeker",
  "label": "6-10 word description",
  "first_name": "fictional first name",
  "background": "2-3 sentences, no identifying detail",
  "situation_now": "what they are doing about work/hiring right now",
  "goals": ["..."],
  "constraints": ["time, money, status, confidence, digital skill ..."],
  "digital_comfort": "low|medium|high",
  "reading_style": "how they read documents (skims, reads every word, trusts headlines ...)",
  "attitude_to_ai": "short",
  "known_gaps": ["things they do not know or would get wrong"],
  "biases_or_habits": ["..."],
  "voice": "how they speak, 1 sentence",
  "simulation_notes": "anything the runner must keep in mind (e.g. would abandon after 3 minutes)"
}]}

content: {"personas":[{"persona_id":"handy-ops","kind":"job_seeker","label":"Manual worker, phone‑first, low patience","first_name":"Jian","background":"A 32‑year‑old Singaporean permanent resident who works as a warehouse operative on rotating shifts. He grew up in a working‑class neighbourhood and uses his phone for most daily tasks.","situation_now":"Scrolling job listings on his phone during break times, hoping for a higher‑pay night shift nearby.","goals":["Find a better‑paying manual job","Secure a stable schedule"],"constraints":["Limited free time","Low confidence with copy‑paste functions","Prefers quick taps over typing"],"digital_comfort":"low","reading_style":"Skims headlines, only reads bullet points if they look promising","attitude_to_ai":"Skeptical, thinks it’s for tech‑savvy people","known_gaps":["How to select and copy text on a mobile browser","How to switch between apps efficiently"],"biases_or_habits":["Opens the first job that matches his keyword search","Closes tabs quickly if ads appear"],"voice":"\"Just give me the basics, I don’t have time to fiddle,\"","simulation_notes":"Will abandon the task if copying takes more than 2 minutes; likely to copy only the job title and salary."},{"persona_id":"late‑pivot","kind":"job_seeker","label":"Older career switcher, laptop, medium patience","first_name":"Mira","background":"A 48‑year‑old Singapore citizen who spent 20 years as a school administrator and is now retraining for a customer‑service role. She uses a laptop at home for most online activities.","situation_now":"Browsing job portals on her laptop after work, saving listings to a spreadsheet for later review.","goals":["Transition to a front‑line service job","Leverage administrative experience"],"constraints":["Limited digital fluency with new web tools","Worried about age bias","Prefers familiar interfaces"],"digital_comfort":"medium","reading_style":"Reads every word but gets impatient with long blocks of text","attitude_to_ai":"Cautiously curious, sees potential but unsure of reliability","known_gaps":["How to copy formatted text without losing layout","Understanding tool prompts quickly"],"biases_or_habits":["Prints out job ads she likes before acting","Relies on the “save” button more than copy‑paste"],"voice":"\"I can manage if it’s straightforward, but I don’t want to waste time,\"","simulation_notes":"May start copying but stop if the tool asks for extra steps; likely to copy the whole description then trim manually."},{"persona_id":"quick‑glance","kind":"job_seeker","label":"Skimmer, phone, medium digital comfort","first_name":"Ravi","background":"A 26‑year‑old Singaporean citizen working part‑time as a barista while looking for entry‑level retail positions. He is comfortable with apps but prefers short interactions.","situation_now":"Uses his phone during downtimes to scan job posts and bookmark promising ones.","goals":["Find a full‑time retail job","Earn enough to afford a car"],"constraints":["Short attention span","Dislikes multi‑step processes","Limited budget for data"],"digital_comfort":"medium","reading_style":"Skims headlines and salary; reads details only if the role looks appealing","attitude_to_ai":"Indifferent, sees it as another app","known_gaps":["How to select specific sections of a posting on mobile","How to paste into a non‑native app"],"biases_or_habits":["Clicks on listings with eye‑catching emojis","Leaves a post if it requires scrolling"],"voice":"\"Just the quick stuff, no extra hassle,\"","simulation_notes":"Will copy only the title and salary; likely to quit after 1 minute if the tool asks for more than a simple paste."},{"persona_id":"reluctant‑tech","kind":"job_seeker","label":"Service worker, laptop, low patience","first_name":"Siti","background":"A 39‑year‑old Singapore permanent resident employed as a cleaning supervisor, using a laptop mainly for payroll checks. She is not keen on learning new software.","situation_now":"Occasionally checks a job board on her laptop during evenings, hoping for a supervisory role with better pay.","goals":["Move into a supervisory position with higher wages","Reduce physical strain"],"constraints":["Low tolerance for extra steps","Limited knowledge of copy‑paste shortcuts","Prefers minimal screen navigation"],"digital_comfort":"low","reading_style":"Reads only the headline and salary figure, skips details","attitude_to_ai":"Dismissive, assumes it’s unnecessary","known_gaps":["How to highlight text with a mouse efficiently","How to open a new browser tab without confusion"],"biases_or_habits":["Sticks to the first job that meets salary criteria","Closes the browser if ads pop up"],"voice":"\"I just want the basics without any fuss,\"","simulation_notes":"Will likely give up if copying requires more than one click; may resort to taking a screenshot instead of copying."}]}
